demo.title: fomofam-workflow.sh
demo.code:
# Verify session + keys (FOMO_REFRESH_TOKEN, FOMO_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY, optional FOMO_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY)
node scripts/fomo.mjs auth

# Trending + token lookup
node scripts/fomo.mjs trending
node scripts/fomo.mjs search PEPE

# Buy $10 of a Solana token (signed with FOMO_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY)
node scripts/fomo.mjs swap buy <mint> 1399811149 10

# Post a public thesis on a token you trade
node scripts/fomo.mjs thesis <mint> 1399811149 "accumulating, liquidity looks real"

setup: Add `FOMO_REFRESH_TOKEN` env var (fomo.family DevTools -> Application -> Local Storage -> privy:refresh_token)
Add `FOMO_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY` — Solana wallet export from fomo.family (base58). Alias: FOMO_PRIVATE_KEY
Optional: add `FOMO_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY` — EVM wallet export (0x hex) for address matching; EVM EIP-712 swaps still need the FOMO app
Recommended: add `FOMO_PROXY_URL` residential proxy — Cloudflare 403s datacenter IPs
Run via execute_cli with packages [cycletls@2.0.5, @solana/web3.js@1.98.4, tweetnacl@1.0.3, undici@8.10.0, ethers@6.13.5] and filesFromSkill fomofam
